quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, H1 2026 results briefing): based on current customer demand guidance and orders, the company expects industry conditions to stay at a high level; 1.6T and 800G are this year's main delivery products, and overall market demand is expected to remain strong.

Management (IR record): 800G shipments kept rising this year and 800G has become the main shipping product; 1.6T optical module shipments in Q2 grew clearly versus Q1, and the company expects the 1.6T ramp to accelerate further in the second half.
quarterly_data.figure: 800G main shipping product; 1.6T Q2 shipments up clearly vs Q1

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the share of silicon photonics products keeps rising with a strong growth trend that is expected to continue next year; LPO products are progressing smoothly with the relevant customers.

Management (IR record): the company is working closely with relevant customers on NPO (near-packaged optics); it expects NPO product deliveries to start in 2027 with batch-order delivery demand, scale shipments to rise further in 2028, and NPO to become one of the company's main products.
quarterly_data.figure: NPO deliveries expected from 2027; scale volume in 2028

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the company has laid out next-generation technologies across NPO, OCS, LPO, CPO, XPO and coherent, and has taken part in CPO-related product development.

Management (IR record): capacity at both the Chengdu and Thailand sites keeps being expanded based on forward order guidance; besides hardware expansion, the company is raising output through more line automation and better equipment, software and fixtures.
Management (IR record): Hongchen Photonics is a supplier to the company (a related company; related-party transactions per the company's public disclosures).
